fr_html: Mr. ROOT attire l'attention sur les vœux provisoirement adoptés par le Comité et qui attendent un vote définitif.
en_html: Mr. ROOT drew attention to the resolutions, which had been provisionally adopted by the Committee, but had yet to be put to a final vote.
